usage: The word '牛肉丁' (ngau4 juk6 ding1) is a noun used to describe small cubes of beef.
'牛肉丁' often appears in food menus and recipes to specify the type of beef cut used.
You can use '牛肉丁' in both formal and casual contexts when talking about cooking or ordering food.
It can be combined with cooking methods, like '炒牛肉丁' (stir-fried diced beef).
'牛肉丁' is countable when referring to portions or servings of diced beef.
